messages:
Leah W.: hey team — quick check: my calendar shows the orientation at 10:00 but there's no join link on the event tile. did the invite change? :confused:
Onboarding Bot: Hi Leah! Official join URL: https://zoom.us/j/3141592654 (passcode: `Redwood2026`). Agenda + slides will be in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/onboarding-session.ics file to add to other calendars: https://redwood.app/ical/orientation_session.ics :calendar:
Diego R.: i had a duplicate too. two invites — one from my team calendar and one from People Ops. accepted People Ops and declined the other, that fixed it.
Alisha P.: timezone note for folks: 10:00 PT = 13:00 ET = 18:00 BST = 02:00 AEST (next day). i'll add a short conversion snippet in the event description for APAC.
Leah W.: thanks! will the main session be recorded and where will the recording go?
People Ops: yes — recording + transcript will be uploaded to the "New Hires" folder in Drive. We post the link in #new-hires within ~1 hour after the session. If you can't make it live, RSVP "No" and you'll still receive the recording link.
Diego R.: quick question on breakout rooms — will those be pre-seeded by team? and are breakout audio/transcripts captured?
Onboarding Bot: Breakouts will be pre-assigned. Main session is recorded and transcribed; breakout rooms are not included in main transcript by default. If you need breakout capture, request an attendee to record locally or ask People Ops to assign a notetaker.
Alisha P.: accessibility: live captions enabled for the main room. if you need a different language or ASL interpreter, DM People Ops and we'll arrange ahead of time.
Leah W.: one last tiny tip — if you're on Outlook and the time looks wrong after accepting, try removing the event and re-importing the .ics; it fixed the DST weirdness for me.
People Ops: reminder checklist: join 5 mins early, have Slack open for links, post questions in the Q&A doc linked in the event. We'll keep it ~75 minutes with Q&A. See you all! :wave:
